description: PreToolUse Write|Edit -> format_pre: prettier languages (jsts/json/yaml/markdown/css/scss) formatted in-process before the write when an in-process prettier is available (project-local or the plugin-managed copy). PostToolUse Write|Edit -> format_post: shell/java/kotlin/python/go/php formatted on disk after the write (subprocess), plus prettier on PATH for prettier languages when no in-process prettier is available.
